# Setup

Load libraries:

```{r load-libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)
```

Load in results from simulations:

```{r load-results}
D1_power_summary <- readRDS("Outputs/D1/Extinct/power_summary.rds")
D2_power_summary <- readRDS("Outputs/D2/Extinct/power_summary.rds")
D3_power_summary <- readRDS("Outputs/D3/Extinct/power_summary.rds")
D4_power_summary <- readRDS("Outputs/D4/Extinct/power_summary.rds")
```

# Extinct Comparison

Compare D1 with D2, D3, and D4:

```{r extinct-comparison}
#| fig-dpi: 600
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 3

D2_joined <- left_join(
  D1_power_summary,
  D2_power_summary,
  by = "model",
  suffix = c("_D1", "_D2")
)

D3_joined <- left_join(
  D1_power_summary,
  D3_power_summary,
  by = "model",
  suffix = c("_D1", "_D3")
)

D4_joined <- left_join(
  D1_power_summary,
  D4_power_summary,
  by = "model",
  suffix = c("_D1", "_D4")
)

D1_plot <- ggplot(D1_power_summary) +
  geom_point(aes(x = early, y = later)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    x = "Average Power Early After Extinction",
    y = "Average Power Later After Extinction",
    title = "D1 (Matched)"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1))

D2_plot <- ggplot(D2_joined) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = early_D1, y = later_D1, xend = early_D2, yend = later_D2), colour = "grey90", linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_point(aes(x = early_D1, y = later_D1), colour = "grey90", size = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(x = early_D2, y = later_D2)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    x = "Average Power Early After Extinction",
    y = "Average Power Later After Extinction",
    title = "D2 (Constant)"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1))

D3_plot <- ggplot(D3_joined) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = early_D1, y = later_D1, xend = early_D3, yend = later_D3), colour = "grey90", linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_point(aes(x = early_D1, y = later_D1), colour = "grey90", size = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(x = early_D3, y = later_D3)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    x = "Average Power Early After Extinction",
    y = "Average Power Later After Extinction",
    title = "D3 (Inverted)"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1))

D4_plot <- ggplot(D4_joined) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = early_D1, y = later_D1, xend = early_D4, yend = later_D4), colour = "grey90", linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_point(aes(x = early_D1, y = later_D1), colour = "grey90", size = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(x = early_D4, y = later_D4)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    x = "Average Power Early After Extinction",
    y = "Average Power Later After Extinction",
    title = "D4 (Increasing)"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1))

ggarrange(D1_plot, D2_plot, D3_plot, D4_plot, ncol = 4)
```
